label: Coffee plant
user_direction: Redesign Coffee plant after Latte bloom

astra_review.recommendation: Accept this exact prepared atlas. No meaningful remaining blocker. Preserve current anatomy and gradual cherry finish rather than risking broad regeneration for small paint differences.

evidence.boundary: All25 frames and24 transitions inspected as static light/dark contacts plus1280px prepared sheet; no live Compose playback. Fine texture/color differences are not treated as structural failures.

resolved_since_initial: Third leaf pair now appears as a smaller apical pair rather than a broad inserted bottom tier.
F7→8 leaf contraction removed; early pair widens.
F1→2 now has a clearly visible green germination tip.
Mature plant has readable six-leaf canopy and four cherries, with staggered warm ripening.
Premature F12 cherry removed through native isolated whole-pose edit; no fruit before F14.

leaf_counts.F1–4: No open leaves; closed growing tip.
leaf_counts.F13–25: Six persistent open leaves in three opposite pairs.

fruit_counts.F14-F15: Two green fruits, one per side.
fruit_counts.F16-F25: Four cherries, two per side, retained through final maturity.

anatomy_audit.branch_continuity: Side fruiting attachments are legible and do not vanish after establishment; no extra late cluster appears.

residuals.note: Replacement F12 has a slightly warmer/broader bean, stronger vein highlights and fuller four-leaf silhouette. At148px its style/proportions fit; no false fruit or meaningful reset. Minor paint variation.
Small lowering of unfolding leaf pair while its spread grows; natural pose change, not a whole-plant reset.
Two restrained green-fruit development stages; materially coherent with later ripening, though not large milestones.
One quiet finish/settling transition after full red ripening. Acceptable for completion; avoid risking the stable plant to force another major event.

row_boundaries.F5→6: Same bean and leaf pair, widening with slight natural lowering.
row_boundaries.F10→11: Four leaves expand without node loss.
row_boundaries.F15→16: Stable bean/plant; four-fruit cluster becomes established.
row_boundaries.F20→21: Retained fruit positions advance from yellow/green to orange/yellow.

transitions.note: Green shoot tip clearly appears above bean seam; meaningful at148px.
Same tip lengthens vertically; bean scale and placement stay stable.
Stem and closed paired tip grow; no reset or lost anatomy.
First opposite leaf pair unfolds from top; wider silhouette replaces closed tip naturally.
First pair lowers slightly while spreading sideways; reads as unfurling rather than whole-plant shrinking. Same bean and two leaves retained.
Same first pair gains visible width and leaf surface.
First pair broadens further; no former contraction/reclosure.
Central stem extends and closed second paired tip emerges; original pair retained.
Second opposite pair opens above the retained lower pair; four leaves now clear.
Both pairs spread, especially the lower pair; steady stem and bean.
Four retained leaves widen slightly; no fruit appears. Bean is a little warmer/broader and leaf-vein gloss stronger from the native replacement, but material and scale remain coherent at148px.
A small third opposite pair develops at the apex, reaching six leaves. No cherry vanishes; established plant silhouette remains coherent despite modest native paint variation.
Six leaves persist; two green fruit forms establish one per side at the same fruiting nodes.
Two green fruit forms and existing six leaves enlarge slightly; no branch loss.
Two side clusters develop to four separately readable green cherries. Bean and established canopy no longer reset scale.
Four green cherries persist and plump slightly; restrained but coherent growth.
Small leaf and fruit fullness changes; quiet stage rather than a new structure. Four fruit identities retained.
One left cherry visibly turns yellow while remaining three stay green; clear start to ripening.
Second left cherry becomes yellow, completing yellow left pair while right pair remains green.
Left pair warms to orange and right pair turns yellow; clear color handoff across row boundary.
Left pair becomes warm red while right pair becomes orange; all four attachments persist.
Right pair warms toward coral-red; ripe left pair stays red. Distinct intermediate color retained.
Right pair reaches warm red, giving four ripe cherries; coherent six-leaf final plant.
Quiet final leaf/fruit settling with the same four red cherries. Acceptable single completion beat; does not justify another broad regeneration.

curation_verification.selected_prepared_additional_changes: Importer shifts F3,F7,F9,F16,F17,F18,F23,F25 exactly +1 pixel horizontally; each matches prior frame after that translation with no other pixel changes. Remaining16 unedited prepared poses are byte-identical.
curation_verification.visual_effect: One-source-pixel alignment changes have no material continuity impact at148px.

astra_review.final_assessment: Distinct bean-to-sprout, two-to-four-to-six glossy leaf progression, side-fruit emergence and staggered green/yellow/orange/red ripening. Coffee identity is clear at148px in both themes. Stable central stem, no lost mature leaves, no disappearing established fruit, no row4 scale reset.

independent_astra_review.method: Independent review of every F1-25 pose in both 148px theme contacts, followed by full prepared atlas inspection. Alpha>=24 bounds checked at key transitions. Whole-frame byte comparison checked the stated F12-only curation against repair-02-prepared.png. Static visual review, not native or live playback proof.
findings: F11 and repaired F12 each show four leaves and zero fruit. F12 enlarges the existing pairs; F13 adds a small third pair for six leaves without prematurely appearing cherries.

F12 bean height, seam attachment and baseline remain coherent with F11/F13. Its slightly broader shape and brighter highlights read as minor painted variation rather than a material replacement or positional reset at 148px.
No cherries appear through F13; F14-15 show two green nodes; F16 establishes four. Those four remain attached and countable through F25, with ripening advancing rather than reversing.

The previous severe row-boundary size resets are absent. F15/F16 heights are 165/167 source pixels; F20/F21 are 175/174. Width and leaf pose variations at these boundaries are small, not whole-subject scale resets.
Six glossy leaves and four red cherries are clear in both themes. No blocking transparency holes, edge clipping or detached fragments were observed.

residuals.finding: F12 is a little broader and more strongly highlighted than its neighbors. Overall bounds go from 179x151 at F11 to 194x158 at F12 to 186x159 at F13; the small width contraction accompanies the new upper pair, without loss of plant height.
Four green cherries inflate subtly, so these poses are quieter than the later ripening frames.
All four cherries are already red at F24. F25 provides a modest foliage/fruit fullness finish rather than a new color milestone; its contribution remains restrained.

curation_check.note: The curation claim is exact for selected-source.png. Subsequent scale-1.0 registration shifts eight otherwise identical complete poses right by one source pixel; verified exact RGBA equality after translation, with no anatomy changes.

independent_astra_review.recommendation: Accept the selected sequence. The F12 repair removes the premature-fruit defect while preserving a coherent four-leaf to six-leaf handoff. Further regeneration is not necessary for anatomy or growth continuity; retain the listed small pacing/material variations as polish residuals.

descriptions.values: A coffee plant unfolding glossy leaves and ripening red cherries.

descriptions.values-pl: Kawowiec rozwija błyszczące liście, a jego czerwone owoce dojrzewają.

boundaries: Native evidence is emulator Compose rendering at the supplied Android version/density, not physical-device coverage.
Tests render exact paused countdown poses with isRunning=false and dynamicColor=false; running tween timing and dynamic colors are not validated.

The isolated snapshot passed build/Detekt; shared-checkout results are recorded only when current logs are supplied. Full unit suite was not rerun.

artifact_generation.operation: whole-capture resize and labeled layout only

native_findings: Bean baseline and plant registration remain visually stable through the row boundaries; no recurrence of the oldF15→16 whole-plant shrink.

F11→12→13: F12 retains exactly four leaves and no fruit. Slightly warmer bean and stronger leaf gloss are visible but fit the surrounding material. No meaningful registration jump or structural reset.
Third leaf pair develops at apex byF13; six mature leaves persist throughF25 without disappearing branches or substituted leaf tiers.
Fruit count:0 throughF13,2 atF14–15,4 fromF16 throughF25. All four retained cherries remain readable during staggered ripening.
Central stem, three leaf tiers and warm red final cherries read clearly at148px on both native themes.
Native finish has no clipped leaves, stray sprite fragments, transparent anatomy holes or colored base rim.
Compact native preview communicates a substantially clearer seed-to-fruiting-coffee-plant progression.

residuals.note: Slight lowering while the first pair spreads; natural unfolding, not a scale reset.
F12 bean/leaf paint is modestly brighter and its four-leaf canopy slightly fuller; acceptable native-edit variation.
Restrained green-fruit expansion stages before the stronger ripening beats.
Quiet final settling after four cherries become red; acceptable completion beat.

native_visual_review.verification_boundary: Actual Compose-rendered paused progress poses captured on Android16/API36 at420dpi, then assembled into148px contacts. This review verifies native static rendering and neighboring-pose continuity; it does not establish live temporal playback or every physical device/filter configuration. No device control or production changes performed by this reviewer.
